matches.rationale: GT1 concerns the incorrect definition of Bregman divergence in Section 2.3 (swapped arguments in the formula). Neither finding addresses this defect; pred_id 1 discusses a proof of Theorem 4.3, and pred_id 2 discusses Claim C.3, both in different sections with different issues.

GT2 concerns the incorrect inequality direction (≤ instead of ≥) in the strong convexity definition in Section 2.4. Neither finding addresses this defect; pred_id 1 discusses Theorem 4.3's proof, and pred_id 2 discusses Claim C.3's inequality direction, which is a different formula in a different location.

GT3 concerns the incorrect normalization (1/T factor) in the calibration error definition in Section 2.1. Neither finding addresses this defect; both findings discuss issues in proofs/claims in later sections (Section 4/Appendix D and Appendix C), not the preliminaries definition.

pred_verdicts.rationale: Reports a proof error in Theorem 4.3 that is not among the ground truth defects.
Reports an inequality direction error in Claim C.3 that is not among the ground truth defects.
